description: This file defines the SimpleSqlSearchEngine class, a naive search engine implementation for SuiteCRM that performs SQL 'LIKE' queries across module tables to find matches based on a search string. It includes methods for retrieving table structures, filtering relevant fields, constructing SQL queries, and executing searches across modules.

classes.name: SimpleSqlSearchEngine
classes.descripcion: A simple, naive search engine class that performs table scans using SQL LIKE queries to find matching records in SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: search
methods.descripcion: Executes a search across all modules and returns search results with the time taken.

methods.name: filterTableStructure
methods.descripcion: Filters table fields to include only varchar or text types relevant for searching.

methods.name: getTableStructure
methods.descripcion: Retrieves the database table structure (field names and types) for a given table.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.descripcion: Validates and prepares the search query, ensuring correct encoding.

methods.name: searchModule
methods.descripcion: Performs a search in a specific module's table and returns matching record IDs.

methods.name: makeSearchQuery
methods.descripcion: Constructs the SQL query string used to perform the LIKE search on the module's table.
